title: Advanced Configuration for Zscaler Client Connector

blocks.text: In the Zscaler Admin Console, you can configure advanced settings for the Zscaler Admin Console itself and Zscaler Client Connector.
On the Advanced Configuration page (Infrastructure > Advanced Settings > Custom Root Cert), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Check the next sync time and manually sync groups between Internet & SaaS and Zscaler Client Connector.
Upload your organization's custom SSL certificate for Zscaler to automatically use with Zscaler Client Connector.
